name: Ahrefs
description: Ahrefs is an AI-powered marketing platform built on a proprietary index of the web, giving SEO specialists, content marketers, and agencies tools for keyword research, backlink analysis, site auditing, and AI visibility tracking.
best_for: Positioned for SEO specialists, content marketers, PPC specialists, brand marketers, and agencies — the vendor reports marketers at 44% of the Fortune 500 use Ahrefs.
features: Keywords Explorer for keyword research and search volume data
Site Explorer and backlink analysis built on a proprietary web index
Rank Tracker for monitoring search rankings
Brand Radar for AI visibility tracking across LLM answers
Site Audit for technical SEO health checks
Content Explorer and AI Content Helper for content research and optimization
Web Analytics and Bot Analytics for website performance
Local SEO tools including Google Business Profile monitoring

alternatives.name: Semrush

alternatives.best_for: Marketers managing combined organic and paid search campaigns

tiers.name: Ahrefs Free (Webmaster Tools)
tiers.notes: Free forever; lets you check rankings, backlinks and run site audits, but only for websites you can verify ownership of (not for competitor research). Billing basis: n/a.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Entry paid tier for keyword research and competitor analysis; cannot purchase extra credit top-ups.

tiers.name: Lite
tiers.notes: 5 projects, 750 tracked keywords; up to 2 extra users at $40/mo each.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: 20 projects, 2,000 tracked keywords; up to 5 extra users at $60/mo each.

tiers.name: Advanced
tiers.notes: 50 projects, 5,000 tracked keywords, API/MCP access; up to 10 extra users at $80/mo each.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Requires annual commitment; uncapped API access and custom features. Exact per-seat/enterprise terms beyond the $1,499/mo headline are not publicly itemized.

cons: No free trial of the full product exists: Ahrefs' own Help Center states "We don't provide any free trials" -- the only no-cost option is the permanently-limited Ahrefs Free (Webmaster Tools) tier, which only works for websites you can verify ownership of, so you cannot trial competitor research, keyword, or content tools without paying.

Every paid tier (Lite $129/mo, Standard $249/mo, Advanced $449/mo) includes only 1 user by default; additional seats are extra and capped per tier -- up to 2 more users at $40/mo each on Lite, up to 5 more at $60/mo on Standard, and up to 10 more at $80/mo on Advanced -- so a small team's real monthly cost is well above the headline single-seat price.

There is a steep, uncushioned jump from the Advanced plan ($449/mo) to Enterprise ($1,499/mo), and Enterprise explicitly requires an annual commitment (no month-to-month option) with pricing details beyond the $1,499/mo headline not made public, making it hard to budget precisely before talking to sales.
